name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/eval-runs/claim - The voice runtime claims the oldest queued evaluation run
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN) — the voice runtime's evaluation-run job API, not for apps. Leases the oldest queued run (or a running one whose worker's lease lapsed, VOICE_EVAL_LEASE_MS default 10 min) to `worker` across all tenants, so the worker can play it and record pass or fail (c1171be1-c7ce-4c6d-acbc-98ffe825bc53#AC1). Body: worker (required). 200 { eval_run } — null when nothing is queued. Errors: missing worker 400; missing/wrong ops token 401/403.

testCases.name: Claim (a run, or null when the queue is empty)

errorCases.message: worker must be a non-empty string of at most 200 characters
